title: Adaptive Learning Update
changes: Added learner word states: New, Recognising, Recall and Usable.
Made Journey mission composition adaptive to current strength and due-review load.
Added delayed same-session repair questions after mistakes.
Mixed weak older vocabulary into later Journey topics to reduce forgetting.
Added specific Sensei learning insights based on the learner's weakest skill.
Added optional Campfire Recall after Journey missions for no-choice self-retrieval.
Added optional Kotoba Rain after Journey missions, prioritising today's and weak words.
Kotoba Rain correct catches now count as moderate recognition evidence rather than full recall evidence.
Kotoba Rain can send missed words directly into a Campfire quick review.
Kotoba Colosseum readiness now uses battle-ready learned words rather than a simple introduced-word minimum.
Removed the animated Village view and its setting; Classic Activity Landmarks are now the only activity view.
Removed unused animated-village assets from the service-worker shell cache.
Bumped all release-controlled files and caches to v11.4.0.
